### Meaning
| infl. | class | meaning                            |
| ----- | ----- | ---------------------------------- |
| ~     | *n.*  | place, location, spot, space, area |
### Connotation
- field, expanse of land
### Semi-synonym
- **mahe** (space, area)
### Etymology
#### Glyph
- inspired by 地 (a stretch of land)
- The native glyph depicts two walls on top of a patch of ground, signifying an enclosure or a section of land -> place
#### Sound
- *a priori:* g=groundedness, u=width/depth
- Related to [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Nature/gun\|gun]] (world)
